new_promises.statement: Maintain operating margin within the 19% to 21% range for the remainder of the year.
new_promises.quote: So, of course, there are some expenses, sometimes it is a question of timing... But generally, we have been controlling costs without touching price and protecting margins.
new_promises.speaker: V. S. Ganesh

new_promises.statement: Full year marketing spend to be in the 4% to 5% range.
new_promises.quote: I think for the entire year, we will still be in that 4% to 5% range.
new_promises.speaker: D. Bandyopadhyay

new_promises.statement: Add anywhere between 8,000 to 9,000 general trade outlets in the current year.
new_promises.quote: year-on-year, we have been adding anywhere between 8,000 outlets to 9,000 outlets per year. The target we have taken upon ourselves this year is also in the similar range.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra
